prompt: Set the fryer to 175 degrees Celsius, and once the oil reads 175 degrees, move basket_2 from the prep table to the fryer.

paths.when: the oil reads above 175 degC at 20 s
the oil never heats: the run stops

why: `set` takes a temperature (0040 A5); reaching it is a `wait until` on the reading, never assumed. The world copy has the oil read 176 degC at 20 s, so `>= 175` is true (a reading of 175 +/- 0.5 is unknown against it).
